title: PR #2 salvage ledger
description: Machine-readable index of every PORT decision in the PR #2 salvage manifests (issue #7). One entry per PORT row across fr-lessons-01-07.md, fr-lessons-08-14.md, ta-lessons-01-07.md, ta-lessons-08-14.md. This ledger is the authoritative record of each ported fragment's lineage (source commit, file, lesson, license-at-source); the in-code profile stamp is a mechanical default only.

id.description: Stable slug, unique across the ledger.

lane.description: Execution child issue for this port.

kind.description: Dominant artifact of the ported fragment.

sourceCommit.description: Commit on claude-mac/issue-1-content where the fragment was authored and stamped CC-BY-4.0.

sourceLesson.description: PR #2 lesson id the fragment comes from.

targetLesson.description: Main lesson (per language) the fragment lands in.

targetConstruction.description: Canonical main-side construction id (existing or to be minted), or null when the fragment attaches to a line/scene without a construction id.

licenseAtSource.description: License stamped on the fragment at its source commit. Recorded lineage; never overwritten by the in-code profile stamp.

status.description: Port commits in lanes #8-#11 flip this to "ported" as each fragment lands.
